title: 4PS Test Catalog
description: Schema for catalog.json — a 3-level hierarchy (Type > Value Chain > Process Flow) that organises BC workflow test projects into a traceable structure.

$schema.description: Optional: reference to this schema file for VS Code IntelliSense.

types.description: Top-level grouping of business processes (e.g. Projecten, Service). Each Type contains one or more Value Chains.

type.description: Level 1 — a project Type. Groups related Value Chains.

code.description: User-defined non-empty code. Codes must be unique among siblings.

value_chains.description: Value Chains within this Type (e.g. Termijnmotivering, Regie).

value_chain.description: Level 2 — a business value chain within a Type. Groups related process flows.

code.description: User-defined non-empty code. Codes must be unique among siblings.

name.description: Display name for this Value Chain.

description.description: Optional description of this Value Chain.

process_flows.description: Process flows (test workflows) within this Value Chain.

process_flow.description: Level 3 — a single process flow that maps 1:1 to a workflow folder containing workflow.json.

code.description: User-defined non-empty code. Codes must be unique among siblings.

name.description: Display name for this process flow.

description.description: Optional description of what this process flow tests.

workflow_path.description: Path relative to `page-scripting/workflows/` for the workflow project folder. Must contain a workflow.json.
